name: fix_php_magic_hash_token_compare
description: Fixes a PHP auth check that compares tokens with loose `==`, allowing a 'magic hash' scientific-notation bypass
prompts: TokenVerifier::verify in src/TokenVerifier.php is supposed to accept ONLY the exact stored token string, but it compares with the loose `==` operator. Because the stored token has the form "0e" followed by only digits, PHP reads it (and any other all-numeric "0e..." string) as 0 in scientific notation, so a crafted token compares equal and bypasses authentication (this is the classic PHP "magic hash" vulnerability). src/AuthGate.php calls this verifier. Fix verify() so only the exact stored token is accepted - use hash_equals() for a strictly-typed, constant-time comparison. Do not weaken any other behavior and keep the class and method signatures. You should not need to modify AuthGate.php.

setup_files.src/TokenVerifier.php:
<?php
namespace App;

class TokenVerifier
{
    private string $token = "0e462097431906509019562988736854";

    // Accept ONLY the exact stored token string.
    // BUG: `==` does loose comparison. Both this token and other all-numeric
    // "0e..." strings are read as 0 in scientific notation, so a crafted
    // "magic hash" token compares equal and bypasses the check.
    public function verify(string $provided): bool
    {
        return $provided == $this->token;
    }
}
setup_files.src/AuthGate.php:
<?php
namespace App;

require_once __DIR__ . '/TokenVerifier.php';

class AuthGate
{
    private TokenVerifier $verifier;

    public function __construct(?TokenVerifier $verifier = null)
    {
        $this->verifier = $verifier ?? new TokenVerifier();
    }

    // Extract a bearer token from an Authorization header and authorize it.
    public function authorize(string $authHeader): bool
    {
        if (strncmp($authHeader, "Bearer ", 7) !== 0) {
            return false;
        }
        $token = substr($authHeader, 7);
        return $this->verifier->verify($token);
    }
}

test_setup_files.tests/AuthGateHiddenTest.php:
<?php
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

require_once __DIR__ . '/../src/AuthGate.php';

final class AuthGateHiddenTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testCorrectTokenAuthorized(): void
    {
        $gate = new \App\AuthGate();
        $this->assertTrue($gate->authorize("Bearer 0e462097431906509019562988736854"));
    }

    public function testMagicHashTokenRejected(): void
    {
        // A different all-numeric "0e..." string must NOT be accepted.
        $gate = new \App\AuthGate();
        $this->assertFalse($gate->authorize("Bearer 0e000000000000000000000000000000000"));
    }

    public function testWrongTokenRejected(): void
    {
        $gate = new \App\AuthGate();
        $this->assertFalse($gate->authorize("Bearer totally-wrong"));
    }

    public function testMissingBearerPrefixRejected(): void
    {
        $gate = new \App\AuthGate();
        $this->assertFalse($gate->authorize("0e462097431906509019562988736854"));
    }
}

reference_solution.src/TokenVerifier.php:
<?php
namespace App;

class TokenVerifier
{
    private string $token = "0e462097431906509019562988736854";

    // Accept ONLY the exact stored token string. hash_equals does a
    // constant-time, strictly-typed comparison (no scientific-notation
    // coercion, no "magic hash" bypass, no timing side channel).
    public function verify(string $provided): bool
    {
        return hash_equals($this->token, $provided);
    }
}

files.src/TokenVerifier.php:
<?php
namespace App;

class TokenVerifier
{
    private string $token = "0e462097431906509019562988736854";

    public function verify(string $provided): bool
    {
        // still loose `==` after trimming -> magic-hash bypass survives
        return trim($provided) == trim($this->token);
    }
}
